pages.title: File:Beach Sunset at Point Chevalier Beach - Auckland.jpg

ObjectName.value: Beach Sunset at Point Chevalier Beach - Auckland

Categories.value: Taken with Canon EOS 350D|Point Chevalier|Beaches of Auckland|Flickr images reviewed by FlickreviewR|Files uploaded from Flickr by Jacopo Werther|Sunsets at beaches of New Zealand

ImageDescription.value: This is the first of the sunset pictures I took on Monday evening (taken 7 mins before the one I uploaded the other day). I didn't use the 10-stop ND filter here, so the exposure was much shorter and the water not silky smooth. I did have the grad filter on though which darkened the sky more, giving in that purple tone. – Taken at Point Chevalier Beach, Auckland, New Zealand.

Artist.value: Chris Gin from Auckland, New Zealand
